description: This file is a controller module for aggregating and returning user and project cost data from MongoDB collections. It defines a utility function for number coercion and an async function to fetch, process, and respond with summarized cost information, handling errors robustly.

methods.name: getAggregatedCosts
methods.description: Controller function for GET /api/llm-costs that fetches user and project data, computes costs, and returns the aggregated result.
